description: Reads the status of an SMI background job. Use it with the jobId that smi_submit_deep_reports, smi_submit_exports, smi_create_deep_report or smi_create_export return when a large batch is still running, to read its outcome. Returns status (pending | processing | completed | failed), a terminal flag, and failedIds with an error when the job failed. While a batch submission job is pending or processing, poll with bounded attempts and backoff, and stop as soon as terminal is true. A release job (type deep_report_release or export_release) stays pending until that report is released, which can take days: do not poll it in a loop. Tell the user they will be notified when the report is released.

jobId.description: Job id returned by smi_submit_deep_reports, smi_submit_exports, smi_create_deep_report or smi_create_export (the batch job id or one of the per-report release job ids).

name: smi_get_job
title: Get Job
